newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVA INSURANCE SELL-OFF COMMENCED - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: LATVA INSURANCE SELL-OFF COMMENCED - REPORT.

text.p: The sell-off of the state insurance company Latva has commenced, the newspaper Diena reported on Tuesday.
The newspaper said that the company was merging with the Ventspils factory to boost its share capital to the minimum level of one million lats, the newspaper said.
Latva's privatisation will proceed by auctioning off a 38.5 percent stake to a strategic investor. An additional 40 percent will be sold this summer for vouchers, the newspaper said.
The strategic investor will have to invest an additional 600,000 lats one month after the auction, Andris Rubenis of the privatisation agency was quoted as saying in the report.
Latva is the third biggest life insurance company in Latvia with a 15 percent share of the local market.
